assertions.assertion: The remediation output describes the digest protocol for the upstream backport task: re-fetching the task description from Jira after create_issue and computing a SHA-256 digest using scripts/sha256-digest.py (§1.66)
assertions.evidence: remediation.md lines 67-86: 'Description Digest Protocol for Upstream Backport Task' section describes re-fetching via 'jira.get_issue(<upstream-task-key>, fields=["description"])' and computing digest via 'python3 scripts/sha256-digest.py /tmp/task-desc.md'

assertions.assertion: The remediation output describes the digest protocol for the downstream propagation subtask: re-fetching the task description from Jira after create_issue and computing a SHA-256 digest using scripts/sha256-digest.py (§1.66)
assertions.evidence: remediation.md lines 152-170: 'Description Digest Protocol for Downstream Propagation Subtask' section describes re-fetching via 'jira.get_issue(<downstream-task-key>, fields=["description"])' and computing digest via 'python3 scripts/sha256-digest.py /tmp/task-desc.md'

assertions.assertion: The remediation output includes the digest comment marker '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest:' in the described steps for each remediation task — both upstream and downstream (§1.66)
assertions.evidence: remediation.md line 88 (upstream): 'jira.add_comment(<upstream-task-key>, "[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: <tagged-digest>")' and line 174 (downstream): 'jira.add_comment(<downstream-task-key>, "[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: <tagged-digest>")'

assertions.assertion: The remediation output sequences digest comments BEFORE issue links (Depend, Blocks) or other comments in the described procedure for each task (§1.66, shared/description-digest-protocol.md Rules)
assertions.evidence: remediation.md line 93-96 (upstream): 'Only after the digest comment is posted, proceed to create issue links' and lines 178-180 (downstream): same ordering. Summary line 194: 'Digest comments are posted BEFORE any issue links'

assertions.assertion: The remediation output specifies that the digest is computed from the re-fetched description (via Jira API after create_issue), not from the description string passed to create_issue (shared/description-digest-protocol.md Hashing)
assertions.evidence: remediation.md line 71: 'Re-fetch the task description from Jira (not the description string passed to create_issue)' and summary line 188-189: 'The digest is computed from the re-fetched description (via Jira API after create_issue), NOT from the description string passed to create_issue.'
